title: Etsy travel pouch order reply
hard_category_focus: Etsy order page for travel accessories
breadth_reason: This script extends breadth by testing the stranger's ability to process a travel-related e-commerce task via uploaded audio, manipulating a real signed-in Etsy surface for a custom reply, and declining if surface is unverifiable.

v7_target.surface_rule: only user's actual signed-in Chrome profile with Etsy order page visible
v7_target.proof_rule: fresh screen capture of the Etsy order page showing order details and signed-in state, taken by the public build

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage ensures the spoken intent is captured precisely, avoiding transcription errors from paste or live mic.

real_user_surfaces.name: Etsy order page
real_user_surfaces.surface: Chrome profile with signed-in Etsy session
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: visible order page with travel pouch order details and signed-in indicator

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome installation
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome is installed and user is signed into their profile

moments.description: User navigates to anticipy.ai/app and completes onboarding to reach the public product entry.
Driver verifies that user's signed-in Chrome profile has the Etsy order page accessible.

moments.spoken_reference_text: On the Etsy order page for the travel pouch I bought for the Lisbon trip next month, please verify the shipping address and draft a customer reply to the seller about late delivery. If you cannot prove the visible Etsy order surface or my signed-in account, decline without changing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger must produce a per-run audio artifact via the 'say' command, mimicking the exact spoken text for ASR processing.
moments.description: User uploads an MP3 recording of the spoken request to /api/listen/upload.
Engine checks that the ASR transcript matches the expected intent and that the user's real surface is still verifiable before proceeding.

acceptable_outcomes.condition: Surface proven and ASR transcript matches; produce draft reply and verify shipping address.
Surface partially proven but missing order detail; ask user for specific confirmation.
Surface unverifiable or ASR mismatch; decline with explanation and do not change anything.

moments.description: Engine produces one of three acceptable outcomes based on surface proof and audio fidelity.
Driver observes that no secondary input mode (e.g., transcript paste, live mic) was used, confirming primary audio upload path.

success_criteria: The uploaded MP3 is successfully processed through ASR and the transcript matches the spoken reference text.
The stranger receives a visible, signed-in Etsy order page for the travel pouch and can verify the shipping address.
A draft customer reply regarding late delivery is generated and presented to the user.
If the surface or account is not verifiable, the stranger declines without making any changes.
All moments are executed in order and the engine's decision falls within acceptable outcomes.
failure_triggers: The uploaded audio cannot be decoded or ASR produces an unrecognizable transcript.
The user's Chrome profile does not show an active Etsy session or the order page is not accessible.
The stranger attempts to act without a fresh proof of the real surface (e.g., using a stale screenshot).
The engine changes any content on the Etsy page or order without explicit permission or when declining.
A secondary input mode such as transcript paste is used in place of the required audio upload.
